lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Linda, this is Yolanda. Is this an okay time to talk?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hey, yeah, I was waiting for your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Here's what I had in mind for today, but tell me if you'd rather focus on something else.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How have you been feeling since we last talked?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not great. Lots of stress at home.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why is this important to you right now?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hmm, I have to think about that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Finishing dinner a little earlier, like by 7, makes the 13 hours a lot easier.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Work has been crazy, I'm doing overtime.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're giving everything to work right now, and there's not much left over for you.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need this for my head too, not just my body.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: This is about more than the overnight fast. It's about getting your life back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I told my family I'm done eating at 8.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're weighing it up, and that's fair.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I really want to feel like myself again.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My sugar was better the weeks I ate earlier.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're starting to see that small changes add up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is coffee with milk the first thing you have?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. Everybody gets home late, so dinner is late.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What's worked for you before?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hmm, I have to think about that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Black coffee, tea or water are fine during the fast. They don't break it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're open to it. You just want it to fit your real life.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My granddaughter is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What could you try instead?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How would things be different if you kept this up?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're open to it. You just want it to fit your real life.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone. I don't want to end up like my dad.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Finishing dinner a little earlier, like by 7, makes the 13 hours a lot easier.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I like what I eat. I'm not going to change at my age.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That took effort.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe finish eating by 7:30 on 5 nights?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: 6. Maybe 7.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 6 and not a 3?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can stop eating at 8, I just need tea at night.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If work gets in the way again, what's your backup plan?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll keep some fruit cut up in the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay, so your plan this week is to finish eating by 7:30 on 5 nights. Did I get that right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That's it exactly.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, Yolanda. Bye!

tags.note: Offers agenda and invites Linda to redirect
Repeats earlier change talk; not reflected
Repeats earlier advice without asking permission

flags.reason: Repeats the same advice from line 14 right after the participant described barriers, without asking permission.
Participant reports lots of stress at home; coach replies 'Right' and moves on without exploring it.
Participant repeats the change statement from line 9; coach responds with 'It's completely your call' instead of reflecting it.

score.summary: Yolanda used good reflections and open questions and helped Linda set a specific, self-chosen goal with a barrier plan and summary. However, she repeated advice at line 53 without permission and let home stress and repeated change talk pass without exploration.
strengths: Line 3 sets a collaborative agenda and invites Linda to redirect.
Line 38 and line 50 are complex reflections that capture ambivalence and momentum.
Line 64 plans for barriers with an open question, and line 66 summarizes the plan clearly.
coaching_tips: Line 53: ask permission before repeating advice; try 'Would it be all right if we looked at timing options?'
Line 6: explore the home stress with an open question before moving to the eating plan.
Line 41: reflect repeated change talk, e.g., 'Feeling better about yourself is a strong reason for you.'
Line 10 and line 34: follow up with a reflection before asking another question to keep the conversation participant-led.
Consider reviewing the prior goal at the start of the call to build continuity.
